title: Numb
lyrics:
[00:21.77]I'm tired of being what you want me to be
[00:25.52]Feeling so faithless, lost under the surface
[00:30.55]Don't know what you're expecting of me
[00:34.11]Put under the pressure of walking in your shoes
[00:39.34]Caught in the undertow, just caught in the undertow
[00:42.61]Every step that I take is another mistake to you
[00:48.06]Caught in the undertow, just caught in the undertow
[00:51.76]I've become so numb, I can't feel you there
[00:57.10]Become so tired, so much more aware
[01:01.15]I'm becoming this, all I want to do
[01:05.46]Is be more like me and be less like you
[01:09.89]Can't you see that you're smothering me?
[01:13.61]Holding too tightly, afraid to lose control
[01:18.15]'Cause everything that you thought I would be
[01:21.95]Has fallen apart right in front of you
[01:27.30]Caught in the undertow, just caught in the undertow
[01:30.58]Every step that I take is another mistake to you
[01:36.05]Caught in the undertow, just caught in the undertow
[01:39.06]And every second I waste is more than I can take
[01:44.07]I've become so numb, I can't feel you there
[01:49.43]Become so tired, so much more aware
[01:53.63]I'm becoming this, all I want to do
[01:57.91]Is be more like me and be less like you
[02:03.16]And I know, I may end up failing, too
[02:11.79]But I know, you were just like me
[02:16.31]With someone disappointed in you
[02:21.24]I've become so numb, I can't feel you there
[02:26.62]Become so tired, so much more aware
[02:30.85]I'm becoming this, all I want to do
[02:35.10]Is be more like me and be less like you
[02:38.84]I've become so numb, I can't feel you there (I'm tired of being what you want me to be)
[02:47.38]I've become so numb, I can't feel you there (I'm tired of being what you want me to be)
